```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Fuel Efficiency vs Weight",
       x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
       y = "Miles per Gallon") +
  theme_minimal()

plot(p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 100)
```
